Fix. June carries the most consequential single day on the project, the 6 June reactor run and its one containment plate, and it is the entry with the least detail anywhere. Write it properly: who was there, what was sampled, how long the plate was incubated and at what temperature. The 25 June school session also disagrees with the Education page on the date and the spelling of the school; settle it once and correct both pages.
